experiment: DD official step-10000 versus two-scene six-step target-view-anchor adapter on scene-disjoint SJTU Skipping Rope f52-68 fixed camera 3
visual_review: All 17 target/source/official/adapted frames reviewed side by side. Target arms repeatedly swing and body jumps with skipping rope; both DD outputs largely hold arms spread near first-frame position and omit most late arm lowering/rope swing. Adapter appearance and scene remain nearly the same as official. Lower full-frame RGB MAE is dominated by largely static studio background and does not represent preserved action.
limits: Single held-out 17-frame scene and two training scenes are insufficient for generalization claims; native real-video hardcase still requires inference review.
